gui.enchantmod.research.title: Research
rune.enchantmod.uruz.desc: Strength. Boost rune: +1 level for each one connected.
rune.enchantmod.thurisaz.desc: Thorn, force. Part of Bane of Arthropods, Thorns and Punch.
rune.enchantmod.ansuz.desc: Breath, speech. Part of Feather Falling.
rune.enchantmod.raidho.desc: Journey. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.kenaz.desc: Torch, fire. Part of Fire Protection and Flame.
rune.enchantmod.gebo.desc: Gift. Part of Silk Touch, with Isa.
rune.enchantmod.wunjo.desc: Joy. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.nauthiz.desc: Need. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.isa.desc: Ice, stillness. Core of Unbreaking. Part of Silk Touch and Frost Walker.
rune.enchantmod.jera.desc: Year, renewal. Core of Mending. Part of Infinity.
rune.enchantmod.eihwaz.desc: Yew, the bow. Core of Power. Part of Flame, Punch and Infinity.
rune.enchantmod.perthro.desc: Hidden lot. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.algiz.desc: Protection. Core of Protection. Part of the other protections.
rune.enchantmod.tiwaz.desc: Victory. Core of Sharpness. Part of Smite, Looting and others.
rune.enchantmod.ehwaz.desc: Horse, movement. Part of Sweeping Edge.

research.enchantmod.efficiency: Speeds up digging with a tool.
research.enchantmod.unbreaking: Makes an item wear out more slowly.
research.enchantmod.mending: Mends the item with the experience you collect.
research.enchantmod.silk_touch: Mines blocks whole instead of breaking them.
research.enchantmod.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders and insects.
rune.enchantmod.fehu.meaning: Herds were the first coin. What you keep grows.
rune.enchantmod.uruz.meaning: The wild ox charges once and never tires.
rune.enchantmod.thurisaz.meaning: A thorn in the giant's path. It strikes what it touches.
rune.enchantmod.ansuz.meaning: A word spoken into the wind. It carries far.
rune.enchantmod.raidho.meaning: The long road rewards the steady rider.
rune.enchantmod.kenaz.meaning: One torch in a dark hall shows the way.
rune.enchantmod.gebo.meaning: A gift given is a debt of honour both ways.
rune.enchantmod.wunjo.meaning: The joy after a hard winter, shared at the fire.
rune.enchantmod.hagalaz.meaning: Hail falls without warning and breaks what it hits.
rune.enchantmod.nauthiz.meaning: Need sparks the fire that comfort never lights.
rune.enchantmod.isa.meaning: The frozen lake holds all things still.
rune.enchantmod.jera.meaning: Seasons turn. What was sown comes back.
rune.enchantmod.eihwaz.meaning: The yew bends, and from it comes the bow.
rune.enchantmod.perthro.meaning: A lot cast in secret. No one sees how it falls.
rune.enchantmod.algiz.meaning: Raised hands turn the storm aside.
rune.enchantmod.sowilo.meaning: The sun climbs and the dark gives way.
rune.enchantmod.tiwaz.meaning: A spear raised for justice wins the day.
rune.enchantmod.berkana.meaning: The birch is first to leaf in the cold spring.
rune.enchantmod.ehwaz.meaning: Horse and rider move as one.
rune.enchantmod.mannaz.meaning: Mankind stands between earth and sky.
rune.enchantmod.laguz.meaning: Water finds its way around every stone.
rune.enchantmod.ingwaz.meaning: The seed rests in the earth and waits.
rune.enchantmod.dagaz.meaning: Dawn breaks and the night is over.
rune.enchantmod.othala.meaning: What the fathers built, the children keep.
research.enchantmod.efficiency.why: Birch grows fast, so the tool works fast.
research.enchantmod.unbreaking.why: Ice holds still and does not wear away.
research.enchantmod.fortune.why: Wealth multiplies what the earth gives.
research.enchantmod.mending.why: The year turns and what broke is made whole.
research.enchantmod.silk_touch.why: A gift held still in ice arrives untouched.
research.enchantmod.sharpness.why: Victory is won by the keenest edge.
research.enchantmod.smite.why: Victory under the sun burns the dead.
research.enchantmod.bane_of_arthropods.w: Victory over the giants' thorny brood.
research.enchantmod.knockback.why: The thorn drives the foe away.
research.enchantmod.fire_aspect.why: The torch lights what the blade touches.
research.enchantmod.looting.why: Victory brings wealth from the fallen.
research.enchantmod.sweeping_edge.why: Victory carried on a swift, wide stride.
research.enchantmod.protection.why: The raised hands guard against all harm.
research.enchantmod.fire_protection.why: Guarding hands hold back the torch's heat.
research.enchantmod.blast_protection.why: Guarding hands hold back the hail of blasts.
research.enchantmod.feather_falling.why: Guarding hands, and breath to soften the fall.
research.enchantmod.respiration.why: Guarding hands carry breath under the water.
research.enchantmod.thorns.why: Guarding hands, and a thorn for whoever strikes.
research.enchantmod.depth_strider.why: Water and the horse: swift through the deep.
research.enchantmod.frost_walker.why: Water meets ice and bears your weight.
research.enchantmod.soul_speed.why: Need drives the horse over the restless souls.
research.enchantmod.swift_sneak.why: The horse moves, and the hidden lot hides the step.
research.enchantmod.power.why: The bow of yew, drawn with all its strength.
research.enchantmod.flame.why: The yew bow loosed with a torch's fire.
research.enchantmod.punch.why: The yew bow, with a thorn's driving force.
research.enchantmod.infinity.why: The yew bow and the year: the quiver renews itself.
